truth.claim: Brooks ch. 2 example: 12 man-months, 3 people, 4 months; milestone met at month 2; 9 left; +2 people; 3 man-months training; >7 left at month 3 with 1 month to go
truth.note: matches the book's worked example as quoted; 12 - 3 = 9; 9 - 2 = 7

truth.claim: OS/360: manager in 1964, over 1,000 at peak, about 5,000 man-years 1963-1966
truth.note: MMM75 preface and ch. 3 as cited; shown as '1,000+' and 'probably'

defects.what: 'OS/360 PEAK · 1,000 PEOPLE / 499,500 PATHS' presents possible pairs as paths of a real project without the word 'possible' on the stage; the claim and honest limits say it, the frame does not
The Monday headline and the honest line are typeset over the ghosted 20-person ring; readable but muddy
The honest line ('Paths count possible pairs, not meetings...') is on the stage only; the captions and transcript carry only the Monday question
Hook frame is blank apart from the caption; the ring arrives after 1 s

one_line: Drawing every path as the ring fills makes n(n-1)/2 felt rather than stated, and Brooks's own arithmetic is quoted straight; ship it.
